paragraphs: Swamiji's advice was this: don't chase things, and don't run from them either. Accept whatever comes. Real freedom means nothing can disturb you. And it's not about gritting your teeth and putting up with things; it's about not being attached.

To make it stick, he told a little story. A mosquito had been sitting on a bull's horn for a long time. Eventually it began to feel guilty and spoke up: Mr Bull, I've been here for ages and I'm probably bothering you. Sorry, I'll leave now.
The bull wasn't troubled in the slightest. Not at all, he replied. Bring your whole family and settle on my horn. What harm could you possibly do to me?
learn: Many of the things that bother us only have power because we let them. Instead of just enduring irritations, build a calm centre that small things can't reach. That isn't indifference; it's freedom.
